evidence_location.quote: Total RNA from PBMCs (~1.5 × 106 cells) was purified using Trizol (Invitrogen, Life Technologies Corporation) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Samples were checked for purity and hybridized on Human U133 Plus 2.0 Arrays (Affymetrix). Microarray intensity data were normalized by RMA

2–3 × 106 PBMCs were thawed and stained with live/dead marker (Alexa Fluor 430, Life Technologies) to exclude dead cells. Cells were then stained with an appropriate antibody cocktail. Cells were washed, fixed, and analyzed on the LSRII flow cytometer (BD).
We evaluated the plasma antibody responses of all vaccinated individuals via hemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) antibody titer assays.

To assess whether or not miRNAs contribute to the differences in response we saw between young and elderly vaccinees, we measured the miRNA expression profiles of 672 human miRNAs on days 1, 3, and 7 after vaccination from a subset of subjects in the 2010 cohort
